title: Workbench Tree Abstract Type Row Spacing
description: Add one extra empty-row-sized vertical gap after abstract type rows in the Workbench tree only, before the next sibling/child block begins. Apply as a structural spacing rule in the shared Workbench tree rendering, not as a hardcoded type-name fix.
summary: Added one extra empty-row-sized (24px) vertical gap after abstract type rows in the Workbench tree by applying `mb-[24px]` to the wrapper div when `type.isAbstract` is true. This is a structural spacing rule driven by the `isAbstract` property, not hardcoded to any type name. Document, tree lines, expand/collapse behavior, actions, and all other spacing remain unchanged.
